2.209.30
Map.Visibility
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The Map.Visibility element specifies whether a Map is hidden. This element is optional. This element
is of type Visibility.
The following is the parent element of the Map.Visibility element.
Parent elements
Map
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Map.Visibility element.
 <xsd:element name="Visibility" type="VisibilityType" minOccurs="0" />
